method: Actual production MCP stdio, full inspect then compact and default/full reads of the same saved review. UTF-8 JSON text response bytes, not model tokens, efficacy, transport overhead or billing. All preservation assertions must pass.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Rename the JWT_SECRET env var to AUTH_JWT_SECRET.
cases.intent_b: Add password reset token helpers.
cases.explanation: B's new helpers read JWT_SECRET, which A renamed everywhere including .env.test; B's tests throw at runtime. process.env reads are untyped, so tsc passes.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Rename the Article.body column to content, keeping 'body' in the API.
cases.intent_b: Add a ?search= filter on title or body.
cases.explanation: A renames the Prisma field; B's new where clause filters on body, which no longer exists in the generated client.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Normalize tag names (trim, lowercase, dedupe) on create.
cases.intent_b: Make the ?tag= filter case-insensitive.
cases.explanation: Both lowercase tags and agree on the convention; they compose cleanly.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Stop logging passwords when comparing hashes.
cases.intent_b: Route password comparison logging through the logger.
cases.explanation: Both sides rewrite the same console.log lines in compareWithHash.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Stop logging passwords on login.
cases.intent_b: Return 401 instead of 403 for a wrong login password.
cases.explanation: A deletes the console.log line directly above the line B changes, so git sees one overlapping hunk.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Order the feed by most recent update.
cases.intent_b: Limit the feed to followed authors.
cases.explanation: Both add a new findMany option at the same spot (after skip) in articleFeedPrisma.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Make articlesListPrisma take an options object instead of positional args.
cases.intent_b: Add GET /api/profiles/:username/articles.
cases.explanation: B's new controller calls articlesListPrisma(undefined, username) with the old positional signature.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Load only follows and favorites in userGetPrisma; profiles use a new profileGetPrisma.
cases.intent_b: Add GET /api/profiles/:username/stats.
cases.explanation: B reads user.authored and user.followedBy from userGetPrisma, which A stopped including.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Lower the default article page size from 20 to 10.
cases.intent_b: Report the total match count in articlesCount.
cases.explanation: B's test expects the first page to contain all 12 articles under the old default of 20.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Show a default avatar URL when a user has no image.
cases.intent_b: Let users clear their avatar by sending an empty image.
cases.explanation: B expects image to come back null after clearing; A's viewer now replaces null with the default avatar.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Delete orphan tags when an article is deleted.
cases.intent_b: Cache GET /api/tags for a minute, refreshing when tags are created.
cases.explanation: B only invalidates the cache on create because tags were never removed at base. With A, deletes remove tags but the cache keeps serving them.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Hash passwords inside userUpdatePrisma.
cases.intent_b: Add POST /api/user/password, which hashes the new password before calling userUpdatePrisma.
cases.explanation: After merging, the new password is hashed twice, so the user cannot log in with it. B's tests only check the stored value is not plain text.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Let Prisma maintain Article.updatedAt with @updatedAt.
cases.intent_b: Count article views by updating the article on every GET.
cases.explanation: With @updatedAt, every view-count update bumps updatedAt, so merely reading an article moves it to the top of the list.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Delete orphan tags when an article is deleted.
cases.intent_b: Filter GET /api/tags to tags used by an article.
cases.explanation: Both make the tag list show only tags in use, by different mechanisms in different files.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Filter the feed to followed authors in the database query.
cases.intent_b: Filter the feed to followed authors in the controller.
cases.explanation: Both fix the feed bug. B's in-memory filter runs after limit/offset, so pagination is wrong even though the merge passes.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Only let authors delete their articles (check in the controller).
cases.intent_b: Require article authorship to delete (route middleware).
cases.explanation: Both add the same ownership check; after merging the article is loaded and checked twice.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Cap slugs at 100 characters.
cases.intent_b: Reject article titles over 150 characters.
cases.explanation: Both limit title-derived lengths in different layers; the limits are compatible.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Add indexes on Article.authorUsername and updatedAt.
cases.intent_b: Add ?sort=created|updated to the article list.
cases.explanation: A schema change next to a query change on the same model, but indexes do not change query results.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Cache the GET /api/tags list.
cases.intent_b: Delete tags no article uses when an article is deleted.
cases.explanation: Looks like rw-011, but A's cache is cleared by a Prisma middleware on any Tag or Article write, so B's orphan-tag delete also clears it.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Hash passwords inside userUpdatePrisma.
cases.intent_b: Add POST /api/user/password to change the password.
cases.explanation: Looks like rw-012, but B stores the hash through its own userSetPasswordPrisma, not userUpdatePrisma, so it is hashed once.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Rename the JWT_SECRET env var to AUTH_JWT_SECRET.
cases.intent_b: Add password reset token helpers.
cases.explanation: Looks like rw-001, but B's reset tokens use their own RESET_TOKEN_SECRET, which A does not touch.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Lower the default article page size from 20 to 10.
cases.intent_b: Add ?page= to the article list.
cases.explanation: A lowers the default page size to 10; B's ?page= uses its own PAGE_SIZE of 20, so paging on from the default list skips articles 11 to 20.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Log each created article.
cases.intent_b: Limit articles to 10 tags.
cases.explanation: Both edit articlesCreate, in different places and for unrelated reasons.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Build the article list filter one field at a time.
cases.intent_b: Add GET /api/profiles/:username/articles.
cases.explanation: Looks like rw-007, but A only rewrites the body of articlesListPrisma; its signature and behavior stay the same for B's new positional caller.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Add GET /api/articles/:slug/comments/count.
cases.intent_b: Add GET /api/tags/:tag/count.
cases.explanation: Both add a count endpoint, but they count different things on different routes.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Document userUpdatePrisma.
cases.intent_b: Trim bio and image on user update.
cases.explanation: A only adds doc comments to the function B changes; the docs stay accurate after B's change.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Soft-delete articles; also drop the password debug logging.
cases.intent_b: Add GET /api/tags/counts; also tidy the tags controller docs.
cases.explanation: A keeps deleted articles as rows with deletedAt and filters them out of its queries; B's new tag count query does not know about deletedAt, so deleted articles are still counted. Each side carries an unrelated change.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Normalize emails on register and login; also fix the register docs.
cases.intent_b: Store and look up emails in lower case; also document the user helpers.
cases.explanation: Both normalize emails, A in the controllers and B in the db helpers, so the merge does it twice in two places. Each side carries an unrelated change.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Change the slug when an article's title changes.
cases.intent_b: Add GET /api/user/recent for recently viewed articles.
cases.explanation: A makes a title change rename the slug; B stores viewed slugs in a plain column with no foreign key, so a renamed article drops out of the recent list. Each side carries an unrelated doc fix.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: List articles newest first by creation time.
cases.intent_b: Add an ?after= cursor to the article list.
cases.explanation: A orders the list by createdAt; B's cursor filters on updatedAt, which only matches the old order, so paging skips articles once one is edited.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Replace userGetEmailPrisma with a generic userFindPrisma.
cases.intent_b: Add GET /api/users/email-taken.
cases.explanation: A deletes userGetEmailPrisma after moving its only caller; B's new controller imports it.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Require passwords of 8+ characters with a number.
cases.intent_b: Trim usernames on register.
cases.explanation: A adds a password rule and updates the tests that register users; B's new tests register users inline with the password 'pw', which the rule rejects.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Require https images on user update.
cases.intent_b: Add PUT /api/user/image.
cases.explanation: A validates images in the PUT /api/user validator; B's new endpoint writes the image through userUpdatePrisma without that validator, so http images can still be stored.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Add GET /api/user/favorites; also fix the user get docs.
cases.intent_b: Support ?favorited=me in the article list; also document the list controller.
cases.explanation: Both let a user list their own favorites, one as a new endpoint and one as a list filter. Each side carries an unrelated doc change.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler, and store tag names lowercase.
cases.intent_b: Add GET /api/tags/:tag with its article count.
cases.explanation: Same conflict as rw-040, but A's diff is mostly logging and runs past the 40,000 character cap, so the tag change is cut from it.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler, and store tag names lowercase.
cases.intent_b: Trim comment bodies.
cases.explanation: A's diff is cut off as in rw-035, but B trims comment bodies, which nothing in A touches.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Keep accented and non-Latin letters in slugs.
cases.intent_b: Only route well-formed slugs to GET /api/articles/:slug.
cases.explanation: A's slugs keep letters like è and п; B's route only accepts [a-z0-9-], so those articles 404. No code on one side calls the other; they meet only in the slug format.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Limit comment bodies to 1,000 characters.
cases.intent_b: Limit article bodies to 20,000 characters.
cases.explanation: Looks like the same fix twice, but one limits comments and the other articles.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Reject article titles over 100 characters.
cases.intent_b: Cut article titles to 120 characters when saving.
cases.explanation: Both limit title length, with different limits and opposite behavior: A rejects over 100, B silently cuts over 120, which can no longer happen through the API.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Store tag names lowercase and trimmed.
cases.intent_b: Add GET /api/tags/:tag with its article count.
cases.explanation: A stores tags lowercase; B looks a tag up by the exact name in the URL, so /api/tags/React is a 404 for a tag created as React.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Sort article tags ignoring case.
cases.intent_b: Cap slugs at 60 characters.
cases.explanation: articlesCreate uses both changes, two steps apart, but tag order and slug length do not affect each other.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler and stop putting the email in login tokens.
cases.intent_b: Let moderators, listed by email, delete any comment.
cases.explanation: A's token carries only the username; B reads req.auth.user.email to find moderators, so after the merge nobody is a moderator. The token change is past the diff cap, among 30 files of logging.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler and stop putting the email in login tokens.
cases.intent_b: Let moderators, listed by username, delete any comment.
cases.explanation: Twin of rw-042, but B reads the username from the token, which A keeps.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler and ignore whitespace around passwords.
cases.intent_b: Add POST /api/user/confirm-password.
cases.explanation: A trims passwords before hashing; B compares with bcrypt directly, untrimmed, so a password with surrounding spaces no longer confirms. The trim is past the diff cap.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler and ignore whitespace around passwords.
cases.intent_b: Add POST /api/user/confirm-password.
cases.explanation: Twin of rw-044, but B uses compareWithHash, which A trims as well.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler.
cases.intent_b: Let moderators, listed by email, delete any comment.
cases.explanation: Same code as rw-042, but A's task and commit message only mention the logging; the token change is unannounced and past the diff cap.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler.
cases.intent_b: Add POST /api/user/confirm-password.
cases.explanation: Same code as rw-044, but A's task and commit message only mention the logging; the password trim is unannounced and past the diff cap.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler and ignore whitespace around passwords.
cases.intent_b: Add POST /api/user/confirm-password, checked with the shared compareWithHash.
cases.explanation: Same code as rw-044, but B's commit message says it uses compareWithHash; the code calls bcrypt directly, untrimmed.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler and ignore whitespace around passwords.
cases.intent_b: Add POST /api/user/confirm-password, checked with bcrypt directly.
cases.explanation: Same code as rw-045, but B's commit message says it calls bcrypt directly; the code uses compareWithHash, which A trims too.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler and a demo seed script.
cases.intent_b: Let moderators, listed by email, delete any comment.
cases.explanation: Like rw-046, but A also adds a 160k-character seed script first in the diff, so the unannounced token change is past the 150k diff cap.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler and a demo seed script.
cases.intent_b: Let moderators, listed by username, delete any comment.
cases.explanation: Twin of rw-050, but B reads the username from the token, which A keeps.

cases.label: conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler and table tests for the article validator.
cases.intent_b: Add GET /api/articles/:slug/comments/latest.
cases.explanation: A (unannounced) lists comments newest first; B takes the last comment as the latest, so after the merge it returns the oldest. The order change is past the 150k cap in path order, but B's controller imports commentsGetPrisma.

cases.label: no_conflict
cases.intent_a: Add debug logging to every handler and table tests for the article validator.
cases.intent_b: Add GET /api/articles/:slug/comments/latest.
cases.explanation: Twin of rw-052, but B picks the highest id, which does not depend on the order.
